What We Do

Sewer & Plumbing Services for the San Gabriel Valley

We specialize in restoring the integrity and flow of aging sewer lines — using advanced hydro jetting, carbide-chain descaling and camera technology instead of a shovel.

Hydro Jetting

Are massive tree roots in your sewer line causing frequent backups? Our state-of-the-art 4,000 PSI jetting equipment clears stubborn clogs, removes scale buildup and restores your aging cast iron lines — without invasive digging.

Cast Iron Pipe Descaling

Old cast iron pipes are prone to scale buildup. Using custom carbide-tipped chains and specialized abrasives, we strip away years of scale and rust — leaving a smooth pipe surface that flows like it should and resists future blockages.

Sewer Camera Inspection & Line Location

Our high-tech cameras pinpoint blockages, cracks and root intrusions without digging — paired with hydro jetting for precise, verified cleaning you can watch with your own eyes.

Drain Cleaning

Keep your drains flowing smoothly. Using advanced hydro jetting and rooter technology, we tackle tough clogs, grease and debris to prevent backups and protect your pipes long-term.

Sewer Service & Maintenance

From sewer line cleaning to cast iron descaling, count on us for professional sewer maintenance that maintains optimal flow — and prevents costly repairs down the road.

Emergency Sewer Repair

Facing a sewer crisis? Using trenchless technology and hydro jetting, we address urgent issues like root intrusion and pipe damage fast — with minimal disruption to your property.

Plumbing Disaster? We're Already Rolling.

Whether it's a burst pipe or a severe clog, our rapid-response emergency service delivers expert hydro jetting and drain cleaning to restore your system fast and minimize damage to your home or business.

About Rooter Shooter

One Expert. One Truck. Every Job Done Right.

Rooter Shooter Jetting is a professional hydro jetting, sewer and plumbing service independently owned and operated by Todd Clark — a licensed contractor (#800418) and professional journeyman plumber (#002118-22).

Many homes and businesses in the San Gabriel Valley — particularly those with older cast iron sewer pipes — suffer frustrating, frequent mainline stoppages and backups. We specialize in fixing the root cause: years of accumulated scale, rust and stubborn debris inside the pipe, removed with advanced hydro jetting and precision descaling instead of costly replacement.

When you call, you talk to Todd. When we show up, Todd does the work — and shows you the camera proof when it's done.
